items.q: Do I need to build an extension?
items.a: You use the manual browser/Network/HAR workflow and AI prompts. The guide walks through the steps. Basic confidence with browser tools and files helps.

items.q: Can I use this with every course?
items.a: The workflow needs available caption text. Some captures contain a full track; others need more playback or a smaller batch. The kit includes optional help for missing or confusing inputs.

items.q: Can AI teach me the whole course?
items.a: Give AI the relevant lessons and a clear task. Captions cover spoken material; return to the video for diagrams, code or demonstrations shown only on screen.

items.q: Is a ready-made caption tool included?
items.a: The current kit contains the guide, workbook, prompts, templates and practice files. You can join the separate free list to request a future tool or another platform.

items.q: Which AI tool do I need?
items.a: Use an assistant that can read the files you supply. A local file-capable assistant can work with a private HAR. AI subscriptions are not included.
